reason: Both projects treat accessibility as a product constraint: NeuroBridge through neurodivergent support tooling, fAImer through multilingual and offline-first access.
NeuroBridge focuses on emotional safety and cognitive accessibility, while VantaAI focuses on digital dignity and reducing online harm.
Both systems use AI or NLP classification to surface safety signals: VantaAI for image-based abuse and deepfakes, LawGorithm for scam/risk analysis.
DelAI is the clearest applied expression of Anita's DSA focus on graph theory, weighted routing, and optimization.
Both projects report measured system improvements: VantaAI reduced inference latency, DelAI improved route efficiency.
StudyBee structures academic material to reduce preparation load; NeuroBridge structures routines, sensory regulation, and focus support.
Both repositories are described as portfolio/search-engine interface studies rather than polished production products.
The repository archive identifies Neurobridge iterations as architectural work on the NeuroBridge adaptive accessibility platform.
